title: The Prisoner Who Knows Your Name
text: A prisoner in a hanging cage, starved to rope and bone, calls one of your Houses by name as you pass beneath. They know things they should not. They say they know who among you has been talking to the rift, and they want out before they say more.

options.label: Listen to what they know. A secret like that is worth the risk.

outcomes.text: It is true, or near enough: a name, a meeting, a letter. Worth knowing. Worth keeping quiet about.
It is a lie, told very well, and it settles into whoever heard it like a splinter that will not work its way out.

options.label: Lower the cage and free them, whatever they have done.

outcomes.text: They are grateful, in a cracked, starved voice, and they have nowhere else to go. They follow you home.
The cage was bait. The ones who hung it were waiting, and they are glad you came.

options.label: Walk on, and let them call after you. A caged tongue tells no truths.

outcomes.text: The prisoner laughs at your backs, and keeps calling the name. The Leader hears it all that night, and the next.
